title: Identifiable Lindblad-style latent neural dynamics
objective: Determine whether a gauge-fixed open-system parameterization provides stable constraints or intervention-predictive structure beyond its exact classical affine state-space representation, under frozen temporal evidence authority that is shared by every model lane.
decision_gates: For a fully observed qubit density state, the time-homogeneous GKSL/Lindblad generator must be treated as exactly equivalent to a three-dimensional classical affine Bloch ODE d r / dt = A r + b; Lindblad notation alone is not dynamical-information novelty.

Synthetic recovery claims must use a declared canonical gauge or generator-level invariants. Hamiltonian identity shifts, collapse-operator global phases, and unitary mixing of a multi-channel collapse basis are not separately identifiable mechanisms.

Parameter projection is not family identification. After recovering canonical parameters from an affine generator, every entry of A and b must be compared with the generator reconstructed from those parameters. The preregistered moderate-SNR synthetic grid requires maximum canonical-structure residual <=0.05.
The synthetic gate must reject a preregistered stable noncanonical affine look-alike whose canonical-structure residual is >=0.10 even though its projected omega/gamma coordinates appear plausible.

Synthetic promotion to the real-trajectory stage requires median normalized recovery error <=0.20 for the declared gauge-fixed Hamiltonian/dephasing/relaxation family, no systematic Hamiltonian sign inversion, an affine-equivalence witness, gauge-nonidentifiability witnesses, canonical-family structure fit, and noncanonical classical-adversary rejection.

Every real trajectory case must materialize a TrajectoryEvidenceAuthority before fitting. It must bind the exact state-tensor SHA-256, trajectory IDs, window start/stop times, fit/calibration/final-evaluation indices, representation-fit subset, time-step policy, purge gap, upstream neural authority fingerprint when available, and exact source revisions.

Representation fitting or latent-dimensionality selection may use only representation_fit_indices, which must be a subset of source fit authority. Calibration and final evaluation windows may never refit the representation.

Temporal windows from different evidence roles may not overlap and must satisfy the declared purge interval. Model fitting may use only legal within-role transition pairs; transitions across fit/calibration/evaluation boundaries are forbidden.

The Lindblad lane, exact affine lane, LDS/Kalman, VAR/oscillator, switching-state, and nonlinear controls must consume the identical trajectory authority fingerprint and state-tensor SHA-256. Recomputed look-alike tensors do not count as matched evidence.

Real-data comparisons must include the exact affine/LDS control corresponding to the fitted state surface, plus LDS/Kalman, VAR/damped-oscillator, switching-state, and a flexible nonlinear control when sample size permits.

A mechanistic claim requires held-out predictive improvement or a clear complexity/stability advantage, bootstrap parameter stability (target ICC >=0.60), and intervention-direction consistency. Equivalent predictive performance cannot be described as uniquely Lindblad information.
If a classical state-space model matches predictive performance and produces more stable or simpler parameters, the Lindblad parameterization is not promoted.
No fitted latent collapse/dephasing parameter may be interpreted as microscopic biological decoherence without an independent physical measurement and discriminating perturbation.
